description: Turn long prompts into clear execution briefs without losing requirements or widening scope.

defaultPrompt: Plan our AI service launch. Keep it under $5K. Include milestones, owners, risks, and metrics. Do not publish or spend…
interface.longDescription: Turn brain dumps, long requests, and messy ideas into structured prompts that are clear enough to execute. Prompt Optimizer organizes the goal, must-keeps, parameters, assumptions, and open decisions without dropping requirements, changing scope, or widening approval. It prepares the prompt; it does not perform the task.
